meta.name: EMPAIA App UI
meta.description: Run EMPAIA analyses from xOpat: pick a slide, draw regions of interest, submit a job and read the results.
meta.longDescription: The user-facing half of the EMPAIA Workbench v3 integration. Lists the examination's slides, lets the pathologist mark regions of interest with xOpat's own annotation tools, submits them to the app as a STANDALONE job, tracks progress, and renders the results — annotations, class values, scalar primitives and pixel-map overlays. Requires the 'empaia-workbench' module and a workbench client embedding the viewer.

status.notEmbedded: This viewer must be opened as an app UI from the EMPAIA Workbench client. Nothing can be loaded standalone.
